cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll investigate the dead office plant. Please don't empty the pot; we need the liquid as it was.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You watered it with your coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll compare it with a fresh cup from the machine. A source is not a conclusion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You put six sugars in yours. The machine didn't do that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six in the comparison cup, then. Label it, please. I would like one properly prepared sample before we assign blame.

reason: Shorten the ending while keeping sample preparation as A practical way of deferring responsibility; no new culprit or botanical fact is introduced.
